entities.summary: Commonwealth Stadium is an open-air, multi-purpose stadium located in the McCauley neighbourhood of Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. It has a seating capacity of 56,302, making it the largest stadium in Canada. Primarily used as the home field of the Edmonton Elks of the Canadian Football League, the stadium also hosts athletics, soccer, rugby union and concerts.
